exposure: early pregnancy dyslipidemia (total cholesterol, LDL-C, triglyceride, HDL-C)
cohort: The study included 613 women with twin pregnancies who delivered between January 2018 and December 2023.
finding: Early pregnancy dyslipidemia was positively associated with preterm birth (<37 weeks) in twin pregnancies, with this association remaining significant in spontaneously conceived or dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies.
